name: Guru
description: Guru lets agents search verified company knowledge, answer questions from it, and draft new cards in the signed-in Guru workspace. Each user signs in to their own Guru account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is our travel expense policy according to Guru?
Find the Guru cards a new support agent should read first.
Draft a Guru card that explains how to reset a customer's password.

apps.name: Guru
apps.description: Knowledge search, answers, and card drafts, over Guru's MCP server with browser sign-in.
